title: A MATLAB Algorithm to Automatically Estimate the QT Interval and Other ECG Parameters and Validation Using a Machine Learning Approach in Congenital Long-QT Syndrome
summary: Methods describe 466 LQTS patients and QT reference comparisons; Results report SVM classification of prolonged QTc (reported accuracy differs by analysis: abstract 78.1%, Results 76.3%). No same-cohort threshold comparator is reported. The publisher lists 2025/10; the first version reporting this result is dated 2025-09-30.
